topic.label: Time and Scheduling
topic.desc: Time and Scheduling: Clocks, Time Zones and Timestamps, Calendars and Scheduling, Durations, Deadlines and Intervals and Temporal Ordering and Event Sequencing.

concepts.label: Calendars and Scheduling
concepts.desc: Calendars, recurring events, business days, holidays and scheduling across people and time zones.

concepts.label: Clocks, Time Zones and Timestamps
concepts.desc: Current time, UTC and local time, IANA time zones, daylight saving, timestamp formats and conversion.

concepts.label: Durations, Deadlines and Intervals
concepts.desc: Elapsed time, deadlines, intervals, time to live and how durations are measured and stated.

concepts.label: Temporal Ordering and Event Sequencing
concepts.desc: Ordering events in time: timelines, causality, clocks across machines, logical and vector clocks.

skills.label: Business Day Calculator
skills.desc: Computes business days between dates for a country's holiday calendar.

skills.label: Meeting Scheduler
skills.desc: Finds meeting times that fit participants in several time zones, avoiding holidays and outside working hours.

skills.label: Time Zone Converter
skills.desc: Converts a time between time zones, accounting for daylight saving, and states the UTC offset used.

skills.label: Timestamp Normalizer
skills.desc: Normalizes timestamps in mixed formats to ISO 8601 UTC and flags ambiguous ones.

skills.label: Deadline Tracker
skills.desc: Computes time remaining to deadlines and flags those at risk.

skills.label: Interval Overlap Checker
skills.desc: Checks whether time intervals overlap and reports the overlap.

skills.label: Event Order Explainer
skills.desc: Explains how events from different machines are ordered (timestamps, logical clocks) and where order is uncertain.

skills.label: Timeline Builder
skills.desc: Builds a timeline from dated events and marks gaps and conflicting dates.

mcp.name: Time MCP
mcp.desc: Time reference MCP server: current time in any IANA time zone and conversion between time zones.
